content.short: Plutus DAO is a premier Arbitrum-native governance aggregator that maximizes yield and liquidity for veTokens.
content.description: Plutus DAO is a premier decentralized governance aggregator built natively for the Arbitrum network, designed to maximize rewards for DeFi participants. The protocol focuses on accumulating governance power (veTokens) from major Arbitrum protocols like GMX and Radiant, tokenizing them into liquid "plsAssets." This allows users to benefit from increased yields and influence without the logistical burden of manually managing lock-up periods or voting weights. Governed by the PLS token, the protocol features a sustainable revenue-sharing model that empowers all participants.
